title: WPSB/133/2021 of RAMAA SHANKAR Vs THE STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND
AT NAINITAL
SHRI JUSTICE S.K. MISHRA, A.C.J.
AND
SHRI JUSTICE ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
07TH MARCH, 2022
WRIT PETITION (S/B) No. 133 of 2021
Between:
Ramaa Shankar. ...Petitioner
and
State of Uttarakhand and others. ...Respondents
Counsel for the
petitioner.

: Mr. Amar Murti Shukla, learned
counsel.
Counsel for respondent
no.1.
Counsel for respondent
no.2.
: Mr. B.P.S. Mer, learned Brief
Holder for the State of
Uttarakhand.
Mr. Pankaj Chaturvedi.

Upon hearing the learned Counsel, the Court made
the following
JUDGMENT: (per Shri S.K. Mishra, A.C.J.)
Mr. Amar Murti Shukla, learned counsel for the
petitioner submits that there are some defects in the
pleadings which cannot be removed, therefore, he wants
to withdraw this writ petition, with liberty to file a fresh
better application.

2
2. In that view of the matter, he is requested to file
a memo of withdrawal. If memo is filed during the course
of the day, same shall be taken on record.
3. The Writ Petition is allowed to be withdrawn with
the aforesaid liberty.
________________
S.K. MISHRA, A.C.J.
___________________
ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
Dt: 07th March, 2022
